segments.text: How do you fit a whole computer in your pocket?
Two boards soldered on top of each other,
Apple started this with the iPhone X, in 2017.
segments.say: Apple started this with the iPhone ten, in twenty seventeen.

segments.text: Stacked, it takes about thirty percent less room.
the storage chip hides inside the sandwich,
and the main chip sits on top,
To fix the storage, you have to split the layers.
